steps.description: Caller-supplied data is admitted only if it satisfies the scenario's declared input contract.
The scenario's declared event resolves to a concrete execution authority responsible for carrying it out.
The resolved execution authority runs against the admitted input and produces a candidate outcome.
The candidate outcome is admitted only if it satisfies the scenario's declared outcome contract.
The admitted outcome, together with any governed transition out of this scenario, resolves to one of the kernel's disposition values (completed, terminated, rejected, failed).
